shrunken_pseudobulk.prediction: convex mixture of the training global mean and training lineage mean

trans_only.rna: training-selected HVGs from log1p counts per 10000, training standardized
trans_only.design: five frozen lineage indicators plus RNA principal components
trans_only.target: log1p of depth-free ATAC composition times 10000
trans_only.output: clipped inverse-log prediction renormalized to a positive composition
trans_only.tie_break: lower PCA rank then larger ridge penalty

shuffled_context.permutation: deterministic no-fixed-point permutation of training RNA across donors within each lineage

smoke_peak_universe: 2000 peaks selected by SHA-256 ranking of stable peak identifiers only
held_atac_firewall: prepare exports training RNA and ATAC plus query RNA; fit and predict withhold the original paired HDF5 and no query ATAC artifact is produced
